evidence_scheme: Each claim not proved on the page carries one class: empirical result (paper and page), engineering check (this chapter's code or shown arithmetic), product claim, speaker judgment (with recording time). Definitions and proved results carry no label. Each section opens with a provenance line.
running_case: Door-unlock face verification: camera at 30 frames per second, visual activity detection gate (option 1: changed fraction Chg_t > c_frac = 0.10 with per-pixel threshold c_pix; option 2: small NN), selection of sharp frames, Siamese encoder f_theta with distance d and threshold c, 1:1 key-card check vs 1:N home allow-list, seasonal covariate shift (scarves, sunglasses), dashboards (re-authentication, accept rate, latency) with bands. Used in every section.
